primitives.name: Identity Axiom
primitives.verbatim_quote: Straight lines which have two points, planes which have three points, parallels to a given line which have one point, in common, coalesce throughout.
primitives.assumptions: Uniqueness of geometric entities determined by minimal defining elements.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when shared elements do not imply full congruence or when additional degrees of freedom exist.
